howToApply: Visit the NPCC official website at www.npcc.gov.in and click on the link for online application.
Read the full advertisement carefully and ensure you fulfill all the eligibility conditions before applying.
Ensure availability of all required documents before filling the application form.
Fill in the online application form with correct and complete information.

Upload the required documents: Matriculation/Birth Certificate, marksheets/degree certificates, proof of post-qualification experience, latest pay-in-slip, Form-16 of last two financial years (if applicable), category certificate (if applicable), disability certificate (if applicable), Income & Asset Certificate for EWS (if applicable), Aadhar Card and any other supporting documents.
Pay the application fee through the payment gateway (Rs. 500/- for General & OBC candidates; Nil for SC/ST/PwBD/EWS/Ex-Servicemen).
Submit the online application on or before 29.08.2026 till 11:59 P.M.
No other mode of application shall be considered.

vacancyList.postName: Canteen Attendant (General Central Service, Group 'C', Non-Gazetted, Non-Ministerial)

howToApply: Visit the regional website of the department: https://incometaxmpcg.gov.in
Fill the online application form available on the website.
Upload passport size photograph (taken not before 3 months from the date of notification) with full name and date.
Upload scanned signature in JPEG/JPG format (thumb impression allowed for PwD/PwBD candidates with blindness and low vision).
Upload required documents: Matriculation Certificate, Community/Caste Certificate (if applicable), Age relaxation documents (if applicable), PwBD Certificate (if applicable), Aadhar Card.
Submit the application online on or before 31.08.2026 (23:00 hrs).
Note: Only one application per candidate. Multiple applications will be summarily rejected.
There is no application fee for any category.

howToApply: Visit the official website: vyapamcg.cgstate.gov.in or https://cgssb.cgstate.gov.in

Take a printout of the submitted online application form and keep it safe.
Error correction (Truti Sudhar) can be done within 3 days after the last date of application (03.09.2026 to 05.09.2026 up to 5:00 PM).

title: CGPSC Recruitment 2026 – Psychiatrist Posts
shortInfo: CGPSC has announced notification for Psychiatrist posts. Required qualification: Any Post Graduate. Last date to apply: 19-08-26.

fees.category: SC/ST/OBC (Non-Creamy Layer) local residents of Chhattisgarh & Divyang (PwD) local residents of Chhattisgarh
All other categories & applicants from outside Chhattisgarh

howToApply: Visit the official website www.psc.cg.gov.in and click on the active application link available during the notified dates.

New applicants must complete Candidate Registration by entering name, father’s name, mother’s name, gender, date of birth, mobile number, email ID, and identity proof ID number, then click ‘Generate OTP’.
Enter the OTP received on your registered mobile number and email ID.
Upload a live photo using the link sent to your registered mobile number (ensure face is clear, both ears visible, eyes open, light-colored background).
Upload your signature (sign on white paper with black ballpoint pen, scan as .JPG file, max 100 KB).
After uploading photo and signature, click ‘Save’ and then click ‘Apply’ for the advertised post from your dashboard.
Fill in all required details carefully in the online application form.
Pay the application fee and portal charges online using Credit Card, Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or other available modes.
After successful payment, download and print the application receipt and payment receipt for future reference.
Ensure Application Status shows ‘Submitted’ and Payment Status shows ‘Paid’ on the acknowledgment page.
Previously registered candidates can log in using their existing Login ID and Password.
